task: Retrospective review of the research route, its drift and whether further investment is justified
authority: Codex root substantive route analysis, direct critical-source review and final acceptance
scope: Workspace records from 2026-09-08 through stage92, selected original records and critical implementation boundaries. Earlier thesis is reviewed via the existing overview, not a new full audit of its raw data. Not every historical experiment was revalidated.
accepted_judgments: The shared-IOMMU performance problem has external and local evidence; no evidence establishes that the entire field is exhausted.
Platform calibration, E2/E3 causal evidence, appropriate strong baselines and negative results remain useful research assets.
Recent exploration drifted from a fixed first-paper problem toward constructing local mechanisms and subsequently seeking enabling conditions; original workflow relevance did not keep pace.
Ending fixed-A8 p5 as the main method after method88 is justified within its tested scope; it does not reject every translation-aware policy.

PN board slowdown is real within the measured configuration. The behavioral-DDR model provides a reachable interference chain, not a full causal explanation of the board's approximately 12.7 percent slowdown.

LM static-example and LW three-PTE savings are reproduced by constructed controls. Neither universal dynamic equivalence nor complete cost equivalence nor exact published COPY-contract coverage is established.

Giving a baseline the entire proposed rule establishes an alternative implementation, not automatically an independent prior solution. Legitimate baseline strengthening remains necessary when concrete omissions are found.

Recommend retaining the problem domain and platform, stopping automatic extensions of current mechanisms, and using a bounded workflow-and-contribution decision before further implementation. This recommendation is not an authorized or started new research run.

recommended_next_decision.suggested_timebox: 1 to 2 working weeks, if the user later resumes research; planning bound, not a completion promise
outputs: One fixed workflow with real or explicitly sourced executable requirements
A useful gap left by relevant executable simple methods under declared information and cost assumptions
One falsifiable contribution claim with a positive case and adjacent negative case
recommended_next_decision.gate: Small analytical or model evidence may precede full implementation cost measurements. Do not require beating all imaginable programs or a full application port before low-cost concept validation.
recommended_next_decision.stop: Archive the particular small topic if its useful gap remains artificial or simple methods cover the real requirement. Preserve platform, baselines and negative results.
